title: [MCP] Add codeunit APIs as MCP tools in MCP configuration
summary: Codeunit APIs are now integrated into MCP configuration as a new object type alongside API pages and queries, with unified selection UI and metadata sourced from the Api Web Service table.
key_points: Codeunits added as an object type in MCP configuration with parity to API pages and queries
All API metadata now unified in Api Web Service table instead of separate lookups
API Overview page redesigned to list pages, queries, and codeunits from single source
Permission model changed from 'Allow Bound Actions' to 'Allow Actions' for codeunit tool invocation
V1 APIs and Base Application beta queries excluded from MCP selection
quote: Adds Codeunit as a new object type in the MCP configuration UI, at parity with API pages and queries
